en: Well done, young rogue. Well done, indeed....
Okothos will train you, $n.
Guse? Jeztor? Are they... flat spin?? Seas of Southshore??
Poor man, this explains so much.
%s winks at $n knowingly.
You're talking to the wrong orc. I don't train novices. Talk to young Whuut over there... and use small words.
Lok'tar Ogar!
Remember, if you harass the rep or spam the channel, your account may be kicked, banned, or worse.

Pleased to meetcha, $c. Me name's Roetten. I lead Reclaimers Incorporated.$B$BMe guild and I specialize in aquiring lost goods. We usually hire brave adventurers and send them off to finish tasks for those who aren't able, or don't have the time.
Thanks $n.  Now let's get out of here!

If I can get the proper ingredients, we can create some explosives that will not only allow me to damage the Venture's Co.'s operations, but also cause a distraction.$B$BI know you're impressed, but it gets better... I'll tell you more soon enough.
I could use a drink and some rest myself.  You'll find it right in the northwest corner of Razor Hill.  Say hi to Innkeeper Grosk for me.
Hahaha, your guards no match for Scourge!
What kin I do for ye, $n?
I'm in the middle of a very important task.  Prospector business.  Unless you have something equally important to say, which I doubt, then you'll have to excuse me.
Drink this, it will help.
Just release me already! I've had enough!
Your soul is bound to me, now!
Maraudon is located in the middle of the western coast of Desolace, in the Valley of Spears.

Yesh, it'sh true, I'm blind as a bat! An' drunk as a ... err, drunk as shomething that getsh drunk.$B$BI'll tell you what, $r. It'sh the drink that keeps me shenses sharp. It'sh common knowledge that when you lose a shense, yer other shenses become more alert. My drunk shense is incredible these days.
Don't forget to stock up on wrapping paper this holiday season!  Nothing says "Wondrous Winter Veil" like wrapped armors and weapons for your friends and family.
Me Grimlok, king!
Ish nu!  That's enough!

Now I'm the one who feels rough around the edges, I honestly don't think there's anything left I can teach you. But you know who can? Bengus Deepforge in Ironforge, now there's a dwarf that knows his steel. Go look him up in The Great Forge of Ironforge, see if he's up to having a new trainee under him.
We hunger for vengeance.
%s shakes his head in disappointment.
I am not fooled by your disguise, temptress. Your time to die has come.
Silence, servant! Vengeance will be mine! Death to Stormwind! Death by chicken!
Get a rope!
Well hello there ladies. Heard about the new plague?
I have lost my Kris of Unspoken Names. Are you able to replace it for me?
%s reaches out towards Captain Beltis as he falls.
Come learn the ways of the hunter. Pride, honor, and tradition.
"..."$B$BThe body of the tauren druid lies still and unmoving.  It would seem as though he has finally passed from this world to his promised great beyond.
The Horde Flag was picked up by $n!
